{{Top|leg}}
'''Fealo''' was an individual who was the partner of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], and the pair once discovered the corpse of a [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] lying in an alley. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Fealo's partner told the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Sai-Ani Kannu]] about the pair's discovery.
